context: A visitor recounts their trip to the museum
purpose: Recount a visit; teach 国立/千葉/２月/８月/１０月/１２月/男女/３つ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 国立美術館、行ってきました。
lines.en: I went to the national museum.
lines.style: happy visitor reporting back, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 千葉の館ですね。どうでしたか？
lines.en: The Chiba branch, yes? How was it?
lines.style: curious manager asking, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ２月の新春展、書道が見事でした。
lines.en: February’s New Year show — the calligraphy was superb.
lines.style: visitor savoring the memory, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ８月の現代美術展も話題でしたよ。
lines.en: August’s contemporary show was talked about too.
lines.style: manager adding context, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: １０月の特別展も気になります。
lines.en: I’m curious about October’s special show too.
lines.style: visitor planning ahead, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: １２月は子ども向けプログラムもあるんです。
lines.en: In December there’s a kids’ program too.
lines.style: manager highlighting it, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 男女・年齢を問わず楽しめる工夫がいいですね。
lines.en: It’s great that men and women of any age can enjoy it.
lines.style: visitor appreciating the care, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ３つのテーマ展示、見比べるのが面白いんです。
lines.en: Comparing the three themed displays is the fun part.
lines.style: manager explaining the appeal, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
